  1 ≤ q.R →
    ∀ {Ω : Type} (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point q.d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point q.d)
      (event : ℕ → (Fin q.n → ℝ) → Option (Fin q.n × ℝ))
      (ans : ℕ → OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.Query q → Ω → OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.Reply q),
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (pts : Fin q.n → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point q.d) (sts : Fin q.n → ℝ) (b : Ω),
          ans k (some (pts, sts)) b = (event k sts).elim none fun r => some (r.1, r.2, g (pts r.1) b)) →
        (∀ k < q.K, event k (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing q.R event k).starts ≠ none) →
          ∀ (j : Fin (q.K + 1)) (ω : ℕ → Ω),
            ∀ k ≤ q.K,
              OracleTemplate.StochasticGradient.advance
                  (fun c s =>
                    (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.ringmaster q).update 1 s
                      (ans c ((OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.ringmaster q).query 1 s).2 (ω c)))
                  k 0 ((OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.ringmaster q).initial 1 j) =
                { count := k,
                  point :=
                    OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g q.gamma
                      (fun m => if m < q.K then OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delays q.R event m else m) q.x0 ω k,
                  points := fun i =>
                    OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g q.gamma
                      (fun m => if m < q.K then OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delays q.R event m else m) q.x0 ω
                      ((OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing q.R event k).iters i),
                  starts := (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing q.R event k).starts,
                  iters := (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing q.R event k).iters,
                  clock := (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing q.R event k).clock, chosen := ↑j,
                  selected :=
                    if ↑j ≤ k then
                      OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g q.gamma
                        (fun m => if m < q.K then OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delays q.R event m else m) q.x0 ω ↑j
                    else q.x0 }

Theorem 4.1 is proved from Lemma C.1 (lemma:descent) and Lemma C.2 (lemma:residual). Lemma 5.1's proof reuses the argument of the proof of Lemma 4.1 (lem:time_R) up to (RQKxmnzvrIUDaroZE); that argument is part of L51's own proof and Lemma 4.1's statement (fixed computation model) is not used, so Lemma 4.1 is excluded. Statements use Algorithm 5 (alg:ringmasternewstops, as requested by the user), Assumptions 1-3 (A1-A3), the universal computation model (MODU), 'any computation model' for Theorem 4.1 (MODA), the definitions of T(R,T_0)/T_K (TDEF) and the problem/eps-stationarity definitions (PROB). Derived supporting nodes: DSTOCH (measure-theoretic steps of the proofs of C.1/C.2), DREC (the analytic core of Theorem 4.1 for the delayed recursion), DEXEC (template execution of Algorithm 5 = delayed recursion with delays <= R-1), DDEAD (the iteration of Lemma 5.1 in the proof of Theorem 5.1). import LongTails.Algorithms.RennalaUniform

open MeasureTheory

namespace OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd

open Rennala

structure Public where
  d : ℕ
  n : ℕ
  gamma : ℝ
  R : ℕ
  x0 : Point d
  K : ℕ

def EpsStationary {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : Point d → ℝ) (x : Ω → Point d)
    (P : Measure Ω) (eps : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Integrable (fun ω => ‖gradient f (x ω)‖ ^ 2) P ∧ (∫ ω, ‖gradient f (x ω)‖ ^ 2 ∂P) ≤ eps

abbrev Query (p : Public) := Option ((Fin p.n → Point p.d) × (Fin p.n → ℝ))

abbrev Reply (p : Public) := Option (Fin p.n × ℝ × Point p.d)

structure State (p : Public) where
  count : ℕ
  point : Point p.d
  points : Fin p.n → Point p.d
  starts : Fin p.n → ℝ
  iters : Fin p.n → ℕ
  clock : ℝ
  chosen : ℕ
  selected : Point p.d

noncomputable def step (p : Public) (s : State p) (reply : Reply p) : State p :=
  Option.elim reply s (fun r =>
    let x := s.point - p.gamma • r.2.2
    ⟨s.count + 1, x,
      fun j => if j = r.1 ∨ p.R ≤ s.count + 1 - s.iters j then x else s.points j,
      fun j => if j = r.1 ∨ p.R ≤ s.count + 1 - s.iters j then r.2.1 else s.starts j,
      fun j => if j = r.1 ∨ p.R ≤ s.count + 1 - s.iters j then s.count + 1 else s.iters j,
      r.2.1, s.chosen, if s.chosen = s.count + 1 then x else s.selected⟩)

noncomputable def ringmaster (p : Public) : Algorithm (Query p) (Reply p) (Point p.d × ℝ) where
  Seed := Fin (p.K + 1)
  law := ⟨(PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (p.K + 1))).toMeasure, inferInstance⟩
  State := State p
  initial j := ⟨0, p.x0, fun _ => p.x0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, 0, j.val, p.x0⟩
  query s := (0, if p.K ≤ s.count then none else some (s.points, s.starts))
  update s reply := if p.K ≤ s.count then s else step p s reply
  output s := (s.selected, s.clock)

noncomputable def eventAnswer (p : Public) (V : Fin p.n → ℝ → ℝ) {Ω : Type}
    (g : Point p.d → Ω → Point p.d) (query : Query p) (seed : Ω) : Reply p :=
  Option.elim query none (fun q =>
    Option.elim (RennalaUniform.earliest (fun i => RennalaUniform.completion (V i) (q.2 i))
        (List.finRange p.n)) none
      (fun e => some (e.1, e.2, g (q.1 e.1) seed)))

noncomputable def eventOracle (p : Public) (V : Fin p.n → ℝ → ℝ) {Ω : Type}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
    (g : Point p.d → Ω → Point p.d) : Oracle (Query p) (Reply p) where
  Seed := fun _ => Ω
  law := P
  answer := fun _ q seed => eventAnswer p V g q.2 seed

noncomputable def arrivalOracle (p : Public) (arrive : ℕ → Fin p.n) {Ω : Type}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
    (g : Point p.d → Ω → Point p.d) : Oracle (Query p) (Reply p) where
  Seed := fun _ => Ω
  law := P
  answer := fun k q seed => Option.elim q.2 none (fun r => some (arrive k, 0, g (r.1 (arrive k)) seed))

noncomputable def history {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (gamma : ℝ)
    (a : ℕ → ℕ) (x0 : Point d) (ξ : ℕ → Ω) : ℕ → ℕ → Point d
  | 0 => fun _ => x0
  | k + 1 => fun j =>
      if j ≤ k then history g gamma a x0 ξ k j
      else history g gamma a x0 ξ k k - gamma • g (history g gamma a x0 ξ k (a k)) (ξ k)

noncomputable def delayedIterate {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (gamma : ℝ)
    (a : ℕ → ℕ) (x0 : Point d) (ξ : ℕ → Ω) (k : ℕ) : Point d :=
  history g gamma a x0 ξ k k

structure Timing (n : ℕ) where
  count : ℕ
  starts : Fin n → ℝ
  iters : Fin n → ℕ
  clock : ℝ

def timingStep {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (s : Timing n) (r : Fin n × ℝ) : Timing n :=
  ⟨s.count + 1,
    fun j => if j = r.1 ∨ R ≤ s.count + 1 - s.iters j then r.2 else s.starts j,
    fun j => if j = r.1 ∨ R ≤ s.count + 1 - s.iters j then s.count + 1 else s.iters j, r.2⟩

def timing {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (event : ℕ → (Fin n → ℝ) → Option (Fin n × ℝ)) : ℕ → Timing n
  | 0 => ⟨0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, 0⟩
  | k + 1 => Option.elim (event k (timing R event k).starts) (timing R event k)
      (timingStep R (timing R event k))

def delays {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (event : ℕ → (Fin n → ℝ) → Option (Fin n × ℝ)) (k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Option.elim (event k (timing R event k).starts) k (fun r => (timing R event k).iters r.1)

noncomputable def completionEvent {n : ℕ} (V : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (_ : ℕ) (starts : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Option (Fin n × ℝ) :=
  RennalaUniform.earliest (fun i => RennalaUniform.completion (V i) (starts i)) (List.finRange n)

end OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd

import outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations
import outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime
import LongTails.Proofs.RingmasterExecution
import LongTails.Proofs.RennalaConvergence

open MeasureTheory
namespace outputs.Proofs.RingmasterConvergence
open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd OracleTemplate.Rennala
open outputs.Algorithms.RingmasterTuning

theorem stepSize_pos (L σ ε : ℝ) (R : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hR : 1 ≤ R) : 0 < stepSize L σ ε R := by sorry

theorem iteration_horizon_sufficient (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.Params) :
    8 * p.R * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε + 16 * p.σ ^ 2 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 ≤
      (iterationHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ p.R : ℝ) := by sorry

theorem time_horizon_sufficient (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.Params)
    (hL : 0 < p.L) (hε : 0 < p.ε) (hΔ : 0 ≤ p.Δ) :
    8 * threshold p.σ p.ε * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε + 16 * p.σ ^ 2 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 ≤
      (timeHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ : ℝ) := by sorry

theorem arrival_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.Params) (K : ℕ)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.valid p)
    (hK : 8 * p.R * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε + 16 * p.σ ^ 2 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 ≤ (K : ℝ))
    (I : Instance p.d) (O : Oracle (Query (outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p))
      (Reply (outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p)))
    (hO : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.admissible p I O) :
    let q := { outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p with K := K }
    outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.successful p I
      (fun z : (ringmasterPoint q).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (ringmasterPoint q) (fun _ => K) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((ringmasterPoint q).law : Measure _).prod (O.law : Measure _), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

theorem iterations_success (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.valid p)
    (I : Instance p.d) (O : Oracle (Query (outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p))
      (Reply (outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p)))
    (hO : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.admissible p I O) :
    let q := outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p
    outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.successful p I
      (fun z : (ringmasterPoint q).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (ringmasterPoint q) (fun _ => iterationHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ p.R) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((ringmasterPoint q).law : Measure _).prod (O.law : Measure _), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

theorem universal_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.Params)
    (hp : 0 < p.L ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧
      ∀ i, RennalaUniform.PowerAssumption (p.power i))
    (I : Instance p.d) (O : Oracle (Query (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p))
      (Reply (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p)))
    (hO : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.admissible p I O) :
    RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => RennalaUniform.work (p.power i) t / 4)
      (max 1 ⌈p.σ ^ 2 / p.ε⌉₊) ⌈48 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε⌉₊ < ⊤ →
    let q := outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p
    outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.successful p I
      (fun z : (ringmaster q).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (ringmaster q) (fun _ => timeHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((ringmaster q).law : Measure _).prod (O.law : Measure _), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

theorem universal_success (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.valid p)
    (I : Instance p.d) (O : Oracle (Query (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p))
      (Reply (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p)))
    (hO : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.admissible p I O) :
    let q := outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p
    outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.successful p I
      (fun z : (ringmaster q).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (ringmaster q) (fun _ => timeHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((ringmaster q).law : Measure _).prod (O.law : Measure _), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

theorem finite_domain_iff (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.Params) (Q : Prop) :
    (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.valid p → Q) ↔
      ((0 < p.L ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧
      ∀ i, RennalaUniform.PowerAssumption (p.power i)) →
        RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => RennalaUniform.work (p.power i) t / 4)
      (max 1 ⌈p.σ ^ 2 / p.ε⌉₊) ⌈48 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε⌉₊ < ⊤ → Q) := by sorry

end outputs.Proofs.RingmasterConvergence

import LongTails.Proofs.RingmasterStochastic
import LongTails.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime
import LongTails.Proofs.MaleniaUniformTiming

open MeasureTheory

namespace OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd

open Rennala

theorem advance_add {St : Type} (F : ℕ → St → St) (a b call : ℕ) (x : St) :
    StochasticGradient.advance F (a + b) call x =
      StochasticGradient.advance F b (call + a) (StochasticGradient.advance F a call x) := by
  induction a generalizing call x with
  | zero => rw [Nat.zero_add, Nat.add_zero]; rfl
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [show a + 1 + b = (a + b) + 1 by omega]
    show StochasticGradient.advance F (a + b) (call + 1) (F call x) = _
    rw [ih, show call + 1 + a = call + (a + 1) by omega]
    rfl

theorem timing_invariant {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (event : ℕ → (Fin n → ℝ) → Option (Fin n × ℝ))
    (k : ℕ) :
    (timing R event k).count ≤ k ∧
      ∀ i, (timing R event k).iters i ≤ (timing R event k).count ∧
        (timing R event k).count < (timing R event k).iters i + R := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact ⟨le_rfl, fun i => ⟨le_rfl, by show 0 < 0 + R; omega⟩⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hc, hi⟩ := ih
    rcases he : event k (timing R event k).starts with _ | r
    · have ht : timing R event (k + 1) = timing R event k := by
        show Option.elim (event k (timing R event k).starts) _ _ = _
        rw [he]
        rfl
      rw [ht]
      exact ⟨by omega, hi⟩
    · have ht : timing R event (k + 1) = timingStep R (timing R event k) r := by
        show Option.elim (event k (timing R event k).starts) _ _ = _
        rw [he]
        rfl
      rw [ht]
      refine ⟨by show (timing R event k).count + 1 ≤ k + 1; omega, fun i => ?_⟩
      show (if i = r.1 ∨ R ≤ (timing R event k).count + 1 - (timing R event k).iters i then
          (timing R event k).count + 1 else (timing R event k).iters i) ≤ (timing R event k).count + 1 ∧
        (timing R event k).count + 1 < (if i = r.1 ∨ R ≤ (timing R event k).count + 1 -
          (timing R event k).iters i then (timing R event k).count + 1 else (timing R event k).iters i) + R
      have h := hi i
      split_ifs with hh
      · omega
      · push Not at hh
        omega

theorem timing_count {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (event : ℕ → (Fin n → ℝ) → Option (Fin n × ℝ)) (k : ℕ)
    (hev : ∀ k' < k, event k' (timing R event k').starts ≠ none) :
    (timing R event k).count = k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp (hev k (Nat.lt_succ_self k))
    have ht : timing R event (k + 1) = timingStep R (timing R event k) r := by
      show Option.elim (event k (timing R event k).starts) _ _ = _
      rw [hr]
      rfl
    rw [ht]
    show (timing R event k).count + 1 = k + 1
    rw [ih (fun k' hk' => hev k' (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk'))]

theorem delays_bound {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (event : ℕ → (Fin n → ℝ) → Option (Fin n × ℝ))
    (K : ℕ) (hev : ∀ k < K, event k (timing R event k).starts ≠ none) (k : ℕ) :
    (fun m => if m < K then delays R event m else m) k ≤ k ∧
      k < (fun m => if m < K then delays R event m else m) k + R := by
  show (if k < K then delays R event k else k) ≤ k ∧ k < (if k < K then delays R event k else k) + R
  split_ifs with hk
  · have hc := timing_count R event k (fun k' hk' => hev k' (lt_trans hk' hk))
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp (hev k hk)
    have hd : delays R event k = (timing R event k).iters r.1 := by
      show Option.elim (event k (timing R event k).starts) k _ = _
      rw [hr]
      rfl
    have hi := (timing_invariant R hR event k).2 r.1
    rw [hd]
    omega
  · omega

theorem advance_ringmaster (q : Public) (hR : 1 ≤ q.R) {Ω : Type} (g : Point q.d → Ω → Point q.d)
    (event : ℕ → (Fin q.n → ℝ) → Option (Fin q.n × ℝ)) (ans : ℕ → Query q → Ω → Reply q)
    (hans : ∀ k pts sts b, ans k (some (pts, sts)) b =
      Option.elim (event k sts) none (fun r => some (r.1, r.2, g (pts r.1) b)))
    (hev : ∀ k < q.K, event k (timing q.R event k).starts ≠ none)
    (j : Fin (q.K + 1)) (ω : ℕ → Ω) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q.K) :
    StochasticGradient.advance (fun c s => (ringmaster q).update s (ans c ((ringmaster q).query s).2 (ω c)))
        k 0 ((ringmaster q).initial j) =
      (⟨k, delayedIterate g q.gamma (fun m => if m < q.K then delays q.R event m else m) q.x0 ω k,
        fun i => delayedIterate g q.gamma (fun m => if m < q.K then delays q.R event m else m) q.x0 ω
          ((timing q.R event k).iters i),
        (timing q.R event k).starts, (timing q.R event k).iters, (timing q.R event k).clock, j.val,
        if j.val ≤ k then delayedIterate g q.gamma (fun m => if m < q.K then delays q.R event m else m)
          q.x0 ω j.val else q.x0⟩ : State q) := by
  set a : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => if m < q.K then delays q.R event m else m with ha
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    show (⟨0, q.x0, fun _ => q.x0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, 0, j.val, q.x0⟩ : State q) = _
    by_cases hj : j.val = 0
    · rw [ite_eq_left (by omega), hj]
      rfl
    · rw [ite_eq_right (by omega)]
      rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    have hkK : k < q.K := by omega
    rw [advance_add, ih (by omega)]
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp (hev k hkK)
    have hc := timing_count q.R event k (fun k' hk' => hev k' (lt_trans hk' hkK))
    have ht : timing q.R event (k + 1) = timingStep q.R (timing q.R event k) r := by
      show Option.elim (event k (timing q.R event k).starts) _ _ = _
      rw [hr]
      rfl
    have hd : a k = (timing q.R event k).iters r.1 := by
      show (if k < q.K then delays q.R event k else k) = _
      rw [ite_eq_left hkK]
      show Option.elim (event k (timing q.R event k).starts) k _ = _
      rw [hr]
      rfl
    have hak : a k ≤ k := (delays_bound q.R hR event q.K hev k).1
    have hX : delayedIterate g q.gamma a q.x0 ω (k + 1) =
        delayedIterate g q.gamma a q.x0 ω k -
          q.gamma • g (delayedIterate g q.gamma a q.x0 ω ((timing q.R event k).iters r.1)) (ω k) := by
      rw [delayedIterate_succ g q.gamma a q.x0 ω k hak, hd]
    show (if q.K ≤ k then _ else step q _ (ans (0 + k) (if q.K ≤ k then none else
      some ((fun i => delayedIterate g q.gamma a q.x0 ω ((timing q.R event k).iters i)),
        (timing q.R event k).starts)) (ω (0 + k)))) = _
    have hnK : ¬ q.K ≤ k := by omega
    rw [ite_eq_right hnK, ite_eq_right hnK, Nat.zero_add, hans, hr, ht]
    set X := delayedIterate g q.gamma a q.x0 ω with hXdef
    set T := timing q.R event k with hT
    change (⟨k + 1, X k - q.gamma • g (X (T.iters r.1)) (ω k),
        fun i => if i = r.1 ∨ q.R ≤ k + 1 - T.iters i then X k - q.gamma • g (X (T.iters r.1)) (ω k)
          else X (T.iters i),
        fun i => if i = r.1 ∨ q.R ≤ k + 1 - T.iters i then r.2 else T.starts i,
        fun i => if i = r.1 ∨ q.R ≤ k + 1 - T.iters i then k + 1 else T.iters i,
        r.2, j.val, if j.val = k + 1 then X k - q.gamma • g (X (T.iters r.1)) (ω k)
          else (if j.val ≤ k then X j.val else q.x0)⟩ : State q) =
      ⟨k + 1, X (k + 1),
        fun i => X (if i = r.1 ∨ q.R ≤ T.count + 1 - T.iters i then T.count + 1 else T.iters i),
        fun i => if i = r.1 ∨ q.R ≤ T.count + 1 - T.iters i then r.2 else T.starts i,
        fun i => if i = r.1 ∨ q.R ≤ T.count + 1 - T.iters i then T.count + 1 else T.iters i,
        r.2, j.val, if j.val ≤ k + 1 then X j.val else q.x0⟩
    rw [hc, ← hX]
    congr 1
    · funext i
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    · by_cases hj : j.val = k + 1
      · rw [ite_eq_left hj, ite_eq_left (by omega), hj]
      · rw [ite_eq_right hj]
        by_cases hjr : j.val ≤ k
        · rw [ite_eq_left hjr, ite_eq_left (by omega)]
        · rw [ite_eq_right hjr, ite_eq_right (by omega)]

theorem timing_some {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (event : ℕ → (Fin n → ℝ) → Option (Fin n × ℝ)) (k : ℕ)
    (r : Fin n × ℝ) (h : event k (timing R event k).starts = some r) :
    timing R event (k + 1) = timingStep R (timing R event k) r := by
  show Option.elim (event k (timing R event k).starts) _ _ = _
  rw [h]
  rfl

theorem completion_clock {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (V : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (V i) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ MonotoneOn (V i) (Set.Ici 0)) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ (timing R (completionEvent V) k).clock ∧
      ∀ i, 0 ≤ (timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts i ∧
        (timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts i ≤ (timing R (completionEvent V) k).clock ∧
        ∀ a, RennalaUniform.completion (V i) ((timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts i) = some a →
          (timing R (completionEvent V) k).clock ≤ a := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨le_rfl, fun i => ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, fun a ha => ?_⟩⟩
    exact (RennalaUniform.completion_spec (V i) (hV i).1 0 le_rfl a ha).1
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hc0, hst⟩ := ih
    rcases he : completionEvent V k (timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts with _ | r
    · have ht : timing R (completionEvent V) (k + 1) = timing R (completionEvent V) k := by
        show Option.elim (completionEvent V k (timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts) _ _ = _
        rw [he]
        rfl
      rw [ht]
      exact ⟨hc0, hst⟩
    · rw [timing_some R (completionEvent V) k r he]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (RennalaUniform.earliest_spec
        (fun i => RennalaUniform.completion (V i) ((timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts i))
        (List.finRange n)).1 r.1 r.2 he
      have hct : (timing R (completionEvent V) k).clock ≤ r.2 := (hst r.1).2.2 r.2 h1
      refine ⟨hc0.trans hct, fun i => ?_⟩
      show 0 ≤ (if i = r.1 ∨ R ≤ (timing R (completionEvent V) k).count + 1 -
          (timing R (completionEvent V) k).iters i then r.2 else (timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts i) ∧
        (if i = r.1 ∨ R ≤ (timing R (completionEvent V) k).count + 1 -
          (timing R (completionEvent V) k).iters i then r.2 else (timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts i) ≤ r.2 ∧
        ∀ a, RennalaUniform.completion (V i) (if i = r.1 ∨ R ≤ (timing R (completionEvent V) k).count + 1 -
          (timing R (completionEvent V) k).iters i then r.2 else (timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts i) =
            some a → r.2 ≤ a
      split_ifs
      · exact ⟨hc0.trans hct, le_rfl, fun a ha =>
          (RennalaUniform.completion_spec (V i) (hV i).1 r.2 (hc0.trans hct) a ha).1⟩
      · exact ⟨(hst i).1, (hst i).2.1.trans hct, fun a ha => h2 i (List.mem_finRange i) a ha⟩

theorem floor_quarter_le (w : ℝ) (c : ℕ) (h : w < (2 + c) / 4) : ((⌊w⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ c := by
  have hf : ((⌊w⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ w := Int.floor_le w
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos c with hc | hc
  · subst hc
    have h1 : ⌊w⌋ < 1 := by
      rw [Int.floor_lt]
      push_cast at h ⊢
      linarith
    have : ⌊w⌋ ≤ 0 := by omega
    push_cast
    exact_mod_cast this
  · have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ c := by exact_mod_cast hc
    linarith

theorem window_updates {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (V : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (V i) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ MonotoneOn (V i) (Set.Ici 0)) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : ∀ k < m, completionEvent V k (timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts ≠ none)
    (T : ℝ) (hT0 : 0 ≤ T)
    (hT : (R : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i T / 4 - V i (timing R (completionEvent V) m).clock / 4⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ)) :
    (∀ k < m + R, completionEvent V k (timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts ≠ none) ∧
      (timing R (completionEvent V) (m + R)).clock ≤ T := by
  classical
  set ev := completionEvent V with hev
  set σ := timing R ev with hσ
  set c := (σ m).clock with hc
  have hm0 := completion_clock R V hV m
  have hcount_m := timing_count R ev m hm
  have hcT : c ≤ T := by
    by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt
    have hle : ∑ i, ((⌊V i T / 4 - V i c / 4⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonpos
      intro i _
      have hVT : V i T ≤ V i c := (hV i).2 (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hT0) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hm0.1) hlt.le
      have h1 : ⌊V i T / 4 - V i c / 4⌋ ≤ 0 := by
        rw [Int.floor_le_iff]
        push_cast
        linarith
      exact_mod_cast h1
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast hR
    linarith
  have main : ∀ l, l ≤ R → (∀ k < m + l, ev k (σ k).starts ≠ none) ∧ (σ (m + l)).clock ≤ T ∧
      ∃ cnt : Fin n → ℕ, ∑ i, cnt i = l ∧ ∀ i,
        ((σ (m + l)).iters i ≤ m ∧ (σ (m + l)).starts i = (σ m).starts i ∧ cnt i = 0) ∨
          (m + 1 ≤ (σ (m + l)).iters i ∧ V i ((σ (m + l)).starts i) ≤ V i c + 1 + cnt i) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      refine ⟨hm, hcT, fun _ => 0, by simp, fun i => Or.inl ⟨?_, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
      have := ((timing_invariant R hR ev m).2 i).1
      rw [hcount_m] at this
      exact this
    | succ l ih =>
      intro hl
      obtain ⟨hevl, hclk, cnt, hsum, hJ⟩ := ih (by omega)
      set S := σ (m + l) with hS
      have hcnt : S.count = m + l := timing_count R ev (m + l) hevl
      have hinv := completion_clock R V hV (m + l)
      have hex : ∃ r, ev (m + l) S.starts = some r ∧ r.2 ≤ T := by
        by_contra hne
        push Not at hne
        have hlt : ∀ i, V i T < V i (S.starts i) + 1 := by
          intro i
          by_contra hge
          push Not at hge
          obtain ⟨a, ha, -, haT, -⟩ := RennalaUniform.completion_attained (V i) (hV i).1 (S.starts i)
            (hinv.2 i).1 T ((hinv.2 i).2.1.trans hclk) hge
          obtain ⟨j, b, hjb⟩ := (RennalaUniform.earliest_spec
            (fun i => RennalaUniform.completion (V i) (S.starts i)) (List.finRange n)).2
            ⟨i, List.mem_finRange i, a, ha⟩
          have hb := ((RennalaUniform.earliest_spec
            (fun i => RennalaUniform.completion (V i) (S.starts i)) (List.finRange n)).1 j b hjb).2 i
            (List.mem_finRange i) a ha
          have := hne (j, b) hjb
          linarith
        have hfl : ∀ i, ((⌊V i T / 4 - V i c / 4⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ cnt i := by
          intro i
          apply floor_quarter_le
          have hci : (0 : ℝ) ≤ cnt i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
          rcases hJ i with ⟨-, hs, -⟩ | ⟨-, hb⟩
          · have h0 := hm0.2 i
            have hVs : V i (S.starts i) ≤ V i c := by
              rw [hs]
              exact (hV i).2 (Set.mem_Ici.mpr h0.1) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hm0.1) h0.2.1
            have := hlt i
            linarith
          · have := hlt i
            linarith
        have h1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hfl i)
        have h2 : ∑ i, ((cnt i : ℕ) : ℝ) = (l : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hsum
        have h3 : (l : ℝ) + 1 ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast hl
        linarith
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hrT⟩ := hex
      have hstep : σ (m + (l + 1)) = timingStep R S r := timing_some R ev (m + l) r hr
      obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := (RennalaUniform.earliest_spec
        (fun i => RennalaUniform.completion (V i) (S.starts i)) (List.finRange n)).1 r.1 r.2 hr
      have hclkr : S.clock ≤ r.2 := (hinv.2 r.1).2.2 r.2 hr1
      have hr0 : 0 ≤ r.2 := hinv.1.trans hclkr
      refine ⟨fun k hk => ?_, ?_, fun i => cnt i + if i = r.1 then 1 else 0, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (m + l) with hk' | hk'
        · exact hevl k hk'
        · obtain rfl : k = m + l := by omega
          rw [hr]
          exact Option.some_ne_none r
      · rw [hstep]
        exact hrT
      · rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hsum, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
        simp
      · have hit : (σ (m + (l + 1))).iters i = if i = r.1 ∨ R ≤ S.count + 1 - S.iters i then
            S.count + 1 else S.iters i := by rw [hstep]; rfl
        have hst : (σ (m + (l + 1))).starts i = if i = r.1 ∨ R ≤ S.count + 1 - S.iters i then
            r.2 else S.starts i := by rw [hstep]; rfl
        rw [hit, hst, hcnt]
        beta_reduce
        by_cases hi : i = r.1
        · subst hi
          rw [ite_eq_left (Or.inl rfl), ite_eq_left (Or.inl rfl), ite_eq_left rfl]
          right
          refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
          have hex := (MaleniaUniform.completion_exact (V r.1) (hV r.1).1 (S.starts r.1)
            (hinv.2 r.1).1 r.2 hr1).2
          rw [hex]
          push_cast
          rcases hJ r.1 with ⟨-, hs, -⟩ | ⟨-, hb⟩
          · have h0 := hm0.2 r.1
            have hVs : V r.1 (S.starts r.1) ≤ V r.1 c := by
              rw [hs]
              exact (hV r.1).2 (Set.mem_Ici.mpr h0.1) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hm0.1) h0.2.1
            have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ cnt r.1 := Nat.cast_nonneg _
            linarith
          · linarith
        · rw [ite_eq_right hi]
          by_cases hres : R ≤ m + l + 1 - S.iters i
          · rw [ite_eq_left (Or.inr hres), ite_eq_left (Or.inr hres)]
            rcases hJ i with ⟨-, hs, hc0⟩ | ⟨hi1, -⟩
            · right
              refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
              rw [hc0]
              have hsr : V i r.2 ≤ V i (S.starts i) + 1 := by
                rcases hci : RennalaUniform.completion (V i) (S.starts i) with _ | b
                · by_contra hgt
                  push Not at hgt
                  obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := RennalaUniform.completion_attained (V i) (hV i).1 (S.starts i)
                    (hinv.2 i).1 r.2 ((hinv.2 i).2.1.trans hclkr) hgt.le
                  rw [hci] at ha
                  cases ha
                · have hb := hr2 i (List.mem_finRange i) b hci
                  have hspec := RennalaUniform.completion_spec (V i) (hV i).1 (S.starts i) (hinv.2 i).1 b hci
                  have hmono := (hV i).2 (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hr0) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr (hr0.trans hb)) hb
                  linarith [hspec.2]
              have h0 := hm0.2 i
              have hVs : V i (S.starts i) ≤ V i c := by
                rw [hs]
                exact (hV i).2 (Set.mem_Ici.mpr h0.1) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hm0.1) h0.2.1
              push_cast
              linarith
            · exfalso
              omega
          · rw [ite_eq_right (by push Not; exact ⟨hi, by omega⟩),
              ite_eq_right (by push Not; exact ⟨hi, by omega⟩)]
            rw [add_zero]
            exact hJ i
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := main R le_rfl
  exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

theorem deadline_updates {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (V : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (V i) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ MonotoneOn (V i) (Set.Ici 0)) (j : ℕ)
    (hfin : RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => V i t / 4) R j < ⊤) :
    (∀ k < j * R, completionEvent V k (timing R (completionEvent V) k).starts ≠ none) ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (timing R (completionEvent V) (j * R)).clock ≤
        RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => V i t / 4) R j := by
  classical
  have hV4 : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun t => V i t / 4) (Set.Ici 0) ∧
      MonotoneOn (fun t => V i t / 4) (Set.Ici 0) := fun i =>
    ⟨(hV i).1.div_const 4, fun a ha b hb hab => by
      have := (hV i).2 ha hb hab
      show V i a / 4 ≤ V i b / 4
      linarith⟩
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨fun k hk => by omega, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.zero_mul]
    show ENNReal.ofReal 0 ≤ 0
    simp
  | succ j ih =>
    have hdj : RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => V i t / 4) R j ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro h
      apply (ne_of_lt hfin)
      show (if RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => V i t / 4) R j = ⊤ then ⊤ else _) = ⊤
      rw [ite_eq_left h]
    obtain ⟨hev, hclk⟩ := ih (lt_of_le_of_ne le_top hdj)
    set τ := (RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => V i t / 4) R j).toReal with hτ
    have hτ0 : 0 ≤ τ := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    have hc0 := (completion_clock R V hV (j * R)).1
    have hcτ : (timing R (completionEvent V) (j * R)).clock ≤ τ := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hdj] at hclk
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hτ0).mp hclk
    have hd1 : RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => V i t / 4) R (j + 1) =
        RennalaUniform.roundTime (fun i t => V i t / 4) R τ := by
      show (if RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => V i t / 4) R j = ⊤ then ⊤ else _) = _
      rw [ite_eq_right hdj]
    have hex : ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ (R : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i t / 4 - V i τ / 4⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      by_contra hne
      apply (ne_of_lt hfin)
      rw [hd1]
      show (if ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ (R : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i t / 4 - V i τ / 4⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) then _ else ⊤) = ⊤
      rw [ite_eq_right hne]
    obtain ⟨ht0, htc⟩ := RennalaUniform.min_attained (fun i t => V i t / 4) hV4
      (fun i => V i τ / 4) (R : ℝ) hex
    set tstar := sInf {t | 0 ≤ t ∧ (R : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i t / 4 - V i τ / 4⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ)} with htstar
    have hd1' : RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => V i t / 4) R (j + 1) = ENNReal.ofReal tstar := by
      rw [hd1]
      show (if ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ (R : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i t / 4 - V i τ / 4⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) then _ else ⊤) = _
      rw [ite_eq_left hex]
    have hcond : (R : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i tstar / 4 -
        V i (timing R (completionEvent V) (j * R)).clock / 4⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      refine htc.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
      have : V i (timing R (completionEvent V) (j * R)).clock ≤ V i τ :=
        (hV i).2 (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hc0) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hτ0) hcτ
      have h2 : V i tstar / 4 - V i τ / 4 ≤ V i tstar / 4 -
          V i (timing R (completionEvent V) (j * R)).clock / 4 := by linarith
      exact_mod_cast Int.floor_mono h2
    obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := window_updates R hR V hV (j * R) hev tstar ht0 hcond
    rw [show (j + 1) * R = j * R + R by ring]
    refine ⟨hw1, ?_⟩
    rw [hd1']
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hw2

theorem roundTime_mono {n : ℕ} (V : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ i, MonotoneOn (V i) (Set.Ici 0)) (S : ℕ) (s s' : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hss : s ≤ s') :
    RennalaUniform.roundTime V S s ≤ RennalaUniform.roundTime V S s' := by
  classical
  by_cases h' : ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ (S : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i t - V i s'⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ)
  · have hsub : {t | 0 ≤ t ∧ (S : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i t - V i s'⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ)} ⊆
        {t | 0 ≤ t ∧ (S : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i t - V i s⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ)} := by
      intro t ht
      refine ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)⟩
      have hm := (hV i) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hs) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr (hs.trans hss)) hss
      exact_mod_cast Int.floor_mono (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h'
    have h : ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ (S : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i t - V i s⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := ⟨t, hsub ht⟩
    show (if ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ (S : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i t - V i s⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) then _ else ⊤) ≤
      (if ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ (S : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i t - V i s'⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) then _ else ⊤)
    rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left ⟨t, ht⟩]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (csInf_le_csInf ⟨0, fun u hu => hu.1⟩ ⟨t, ht⟩ hsub)
  · show _ ≤ (if ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ (S : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ((⌊V i t - V i s'⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) then _ else ⊤)
    rw [ite_eq_right h']
    exact le_top

end OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd

structure Params where

  n : ℕ
  L : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  x0 : Point d
  R : ℕ

noncomputable def publicInput (p : Params) : Public where
  d := p.d
  n := p.n
  gamma := stepSize p.L p.σ p.ε p.R
  R := p.R
  x0 := p.x0
  K := iterationHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ p.R

noncomputable abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance p := Instance p.d
  Query := Query
  Reply := Reply
  Output p := Point p.d
  publicInput := publicInput
  valid p := 0 < p.L ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧ 1 ≤ p.R
  admissible p I O :=
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt I.f (gradient I.f x) x) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖gradient I.f x - gradient I.f y‖ ≤ p.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∀ x, I.lower ≤ I.f x) ∧
    I.f p.x0 - I.lower ≤ p.Δ ∧
    ∃ (Ω : Type) (m : MeasurableSpace Ω),
      letI := m
      ∃ (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
        (g : Point p.d → Ω → Point p.d) (arrive : ℕ → Fin p.n),
        LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → Ω) => ξ k)
          (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ∧
        LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (Point p.d) Ω
          (μ : Measure Ω) I.f g p.σ ∧
        O = arrivalOracle (publicInput p) arrive P g
  successful p I output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => ‖gradient I.f (output ω)‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure _) ∧
    (∫ ω, ‖gradient I.f (output ω)‖ ^ 2 ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε
  allowedAlgorithm q A := A = ringmasterPoint q

end outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations

      (max 1 ⌈p.σ ^ 2 / p.ε⌉₊) ⌈48 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε⌉₊ < ⊤
  admissible p I O :=
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt I.f (gradient I.f x) x) ∧

    (∀ x, I.lower ≤ I.f x) ∧

    ∃ (Ω : Type) (m : MeasurableSpace Ω),

  successful p I output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => ‖gradient I.f (output ω).1‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure _) ∧
    (∫ ω, ‖gradient I.f (output ω).1‖ ^ 2 ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε ∧

      RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => RennalaUniform.work (p.power i) t / 4) 
        (max 1 ⌈p.σ ^ 2 / p.ε⌉₊) ⌈48 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε⌉₊)

stoch.source:
import LongTails.Setups.RingmasterIterations
import LongTails.Proofs.RennalaStochastic
import LongTails.Proofs.AdaptiveIID
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.SpecialFunctions.Inner

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators RealInnerProductSpace

namespace OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd

open Rennala

variable {d : ℕ} {Ω Ξ : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ξ]

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ξ] in
theorem history_stable (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (gamma : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (x0 : Point d)
    (ξ : ℕ → Ω) (k j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) :
    history g gamma a x0 ξ k j = delayedIterate g gamma a x0 ξ j := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    obtain rfl : j = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hj
    rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (k + 1) with h | h
    · have h' : j ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp h
      change (if j ≤ k then history g gamma a x0 ξ k j
        else history g gamma a x0 ξ k k - gamma • g (history g gamma a x0 ξ k (a k)) (ξ k)) = _
      rw [ite_eq_left h', ih h']
    · obtain rfl : j = k + 1 := le_antisymm hj h
      rfl

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ξ] in
theorem delayedIterate_succ (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (gamma : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (x0 : Point d)
    (ξ : ℕ → Ω) (k : ℕ) (hk : a k ≤ k) :
    delayedIterate g gamma a x0 ξ (k + 1) =
      delayedIterate g gamma a x0 ξ k - gamma • g (delayedIterate g gamma a x0 ξ (a k)) (ξ k) := by
  change (if k + 1 ≤ k then history g gamma a x0 ξ k (k + 1)
    else history g gamma a x0 ξ k k - gamma • g (history g gamma a x0 ξ k (a k)) (ξ k)) = _
  rw [ite_eq_right (Nat.not_succ_le_self k), history_stable g gamma a x0 ξ k (a k) hk]
  rfl

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ξ] in
theorem delayedIterate_zero (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (gamma : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (x0 : Point d)
    (ξ : ℕ → Ω) : delayedIterate g gamma a x0 ξ 0 = x0 := by
  rfl

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ξ] in
theorem history_congr (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (gamma : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (x0 : Point d)
    (ξ ξ' : ℕ → Ω) (k : ℕ) (h : ∀ j < k, ξ j = ξ' j) (j : ℕ) :
    history g gamma a x0 ξ k j = history g gamma a x0 ξ' k j := by
  induction k generalizing j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    have ih' := ih (fun i hi => h i (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi))
    change (if j ≤ k then history g gamma a x0 ξ k j
        else history g gamma a x0 ξ k k - gamma • g (history g gamma a x0 ξ k (a k)) (ξ k)) =
      (if j ≤ k then history g gamma a x0 ξ' k j
        else history g gamma a x0 ξ' k k - gamma • g (history g gamma a x0 ξ' k (a k)) (ξ' k))
    rw [ih' j, ih' k, ih' (a k), h k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)]

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ξ] in
theorem delayedIterate_congr (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (gamma : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (x0 : Point d)
    (ξ ξ' : ℕ → Ω) (k : ℕ) (h : ∀ j < k, ξ j = ξ' j) :
    delayedIterate g gamma a x0 ξ k = delayedIterate g gamma a x0 ξ' k := by
  exact history_congr g gamma a x0 ξ ξ' k h k

omit [MeasurableSpace Ξ] in
theorem history_measurable (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (hg : Measurable (Function.uncurry g))
    (gamma : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (x0 : Point d) (k j : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun ξ : ℕ → Ω => history g gamma a x0 ξ k j) := by
  induction k generalizing j with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ k ih =>
    change Measurable (fun ξ : ℕ → Ω => if j ≤ k then history g gamma a x0 ξ k j
        else history g gamma a x0 ξ k k - gamma • g (history g gamma a x0 ξ k (a k)) (ξ k))
    by_cases hj : j ≤ k
    · simp only [ite_eq_left hj]
      exact ih j
    · simp only [ite_eq_right hj]
      exact (ih k).sub ((hg.comp ((ih (a k)).prodMk (measurable_pi_apply k))).const_smul gamma)

omit [MeasurableSpace Ξ] in
theorem delayedIterate_measurable (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (hg : Measurable (Function.uncurry g))
    (gamma : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (x0 : Point d) (k : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun ξ : ℕ → Ω => delayedIterate g gamma a x0 ξ k) := by
  exact history_measurable g hg gamma a x0 k k

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ξ] in
theorem delayedIterate_telescope (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (gamma : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (x0 : Point d)
    (ξ : ℕ → Ω) (ha : ∀ k, a k ≤ k) (b m : ℕ) (hbm : b ≤ m) :
    delayedIterate g gamma a x0 ξ m = delayedIterate g gamma a x0 ξ b -
      gamma • ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico b m, g (delayedIterate g gamma a x0 ξ (a j)) (ξ j) := by
  induction m, hbm using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp
  | succ m hbm ih =>
    rw [delayedIterate_succ g gamma a x0 ξ m (ha m), ih, Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top hbm, smul_add]
    exact sub_sub _ _ _

theorem step_integral (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω)
    (hiid : LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure Ξ))
    (k : ℕ) (Φ : (ℕ → Ω) → Ω → ℝ) (hΦ : Measurable (Function.uncurry Φ))
    (hk : ∀ s s' b, (∀ j < k, s j = s' j) → Φ s b = Φ s' b) :
    (Integrable (fun ω => Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω)) (P : Measure Ξ) ↔
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : Measure Ξ), Integrable (fun b => Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b) (μ : Measure Ω)) ∧
        Integrable (fun ω => ∫ b, ‖Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b‖ ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) (P : Measure Ξ)) ∧
    (Integrable (fun ω => Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω)) (P : Measure Ξ) →
      (∫ ω, Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω) ∂(P : Measure Ξ)) =
        ∫ ω, (∫ b, Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) ∂(P : Measure Ξ)) := by
  classical
  have hne : Nonempty Ξ := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure (P : Measure Ξ)
  obtain ⟨ω0⟩ := hne
  let c : Ω := ξ 0 ω0
  let ext : (Fin k → Ω) → ℕ → Ω := fun a j => if h : j < k then a ⟨j, h⟩ else c
  have hext : Measurable ext := by
    refine Measurable.of_eval (fun j => ?_)
    by_cases h : j < k
    · simp only [ext, dite_eq_left h]
      exact measurable_pi_apply _
    · simp only [ext, dite_eq_right h]
      exact measurable_const
  let X : Ξ → Fin k → Ω := fun ω i => ξ i ω
  let Y : Ξ → Ω := ξ k
  have hXm : Measurable X := Measurable.of_eval (fun i => hiid.measurable i)
  have hYm : Measurable Y := hiid.measurable k
  let Ψ : (Fin k → Ω) × Ω → ℝ := fun z => Φ (ext z.1) z.2
  have hΨ : Measurable Ψ := hΦ.comp ((hext.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hagree (ω : Ξ) (b : Ω) : Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b = Ψ (X ω, b) := by
    apply hk
    intro j hj
    simp only [ext, X, dite_eq_left hj]
  have hind : IndepFun X Y (P : Measure Ξ) := by
    have h := (hiid.prefix_tail_independent k).comp measurable_id (measurable_pi_apply 0)
    exact h
  have hlaw : (P : Measure Ξ).map (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) =
      ((P : Measure Ξ).map X).prod (μ : Measure Ω) := by
    rw [hind.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hXm.aemeasurable hYm.aemeasurable, hiid.marginal k]
  have hXYm : Measurable (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) := hXm.prodMk hYm
  have hcomp : (fun ω => Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω)) = Ψ ∘ (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) := by
    funext ω
    exact hagree ω (ξ k ω)
  have hiff : Integrable (fun ω => Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω)) (P : Measure Ξ) ↔
      Integrable Ψ (((P : Measure Ξ).map X).prod (μ : Measure Ω)) := by
    rw [hcomp, ← hlaw]
    exact (integrable_map_measure hΨ.aestronglyMeasurable hXYm.aemeasurable).symm
  have hinner_m : StronglyMeasurable (fun a => ∫ b, Ψ (a, b) ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) :=
    hΨ.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
  have hinner_norm_m : StronglyMeasurable (fun a => ∫ b, ‖Ψ (a, b)‖ ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) :=
    hΨ.norm.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hiff, integrable_prod_iff hΨ.aestronglyMeasurable]
    have h1 : (∀ᵐ a ∂((P : Measure Ξ).map X), Integrable (fun b => Ψ (a, b)) (μ : Measure Ω)) ↔
        ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : Measure Ξ), Integrable (fun b => Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b) (μ : Measure Ω) := by
      simp_rw [hagree]
      exact ae_map_iff hXm.aemeasurable (measurableSet_integrable hΨ.stronglyMeasurable)
    have h2 : Integrable (fun a => ∫ b, ‖Ψ (a, b)‖ ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) ((P : Measure Ξ).map X) ↔
        Integrable (fun ω => ∫ b, ‖Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b‖ ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) (P : Measure Ξ) := by
      simp_rw [hagree]
      exact integrable_map_measure hinner_norm_m.aestronglyMeasurable hXm.aemeasurable
    rw [h1, h2]
  · intro hint
    have hΨi := hiff.mp hint
    rw [hcomp]
    change (∫ ω, Ψ (X ω, Y ω) ∂(P : Measure Ξ)) = _
    rw [← integral_map hXYm.aemeasurable (by rw [hlaw]; exact hΨ.aestronglyMeasurable), hlaw,
      integral_prod Ψ hΨi]
    simp_rw [hagree]
    exact integral_map hXm.aemeasurable hinner_m.aestronglyMeasurable

omit [MeasurableSpace Ξ] in
theorem oracle_moments (f : Point d → ℝ) (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
    (sigma : ℝ)
    (ho : LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (Point d) Ω
      (μ : Measure Ω) f g sigma) (y : Point d) :
    Integrable (fun b => ‖g y b‖ ^ 2) (μ : Measure Ω) ∧
      (∫ b, ‖g y b‖ ^ 2 ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) ≤ sigma ^ 2 + ‖gradient f y‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hdec (b : Ω) : ‖g y b‖ ^ 2 = ‖g y b - gradient f y‖ ^ 2 +
      (2 * (inner ℝ (gradient f y) (g y b)) - ‖gradient f y‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_comm]
    ring
  have hi1 := ho.variance_integrable y
  have hi2 : Integrable (fun b => 2 * (inner ℝ (gradient f y) (g y b)) - ‖gradient f y‖ ^ 2) (μ : Measure Ω) :=
    ((Integrable.const_inner (gradient f y) (ho.integrable y)).const_mul 2).sub (integrable_const _)
  have hfun : (fun b => ‖g y b‖ ^ 2) = fun b => ‖g y b - gradient f y‖ ^ 2 +
      (2 * (inner ℝ (gradient f y) (g y b)) - ‖gradient f y‖ ^ 2) := funext hdec
  refine ⟨by rw [hfun]; exact hi1.add hi2, ?_⟩
  rw [hfun, integral_add hi1 hi2, integral_sub ((Integrable.const_inner (gradient f y)
    (ho.integrable y)).const_mul 2) (integrable_const _), integral_const_mul,
    integral_inner (ho.integrable y), ho.unbiased y, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
  have := ho.variance y
  linarith

theorem step_bound (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω)
    (hiid : LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure Ξ))
    (k : ℕ) (Φ : (ℕ → Ω) → Ω → ℝ) (hΦ : Measurable (Function.uncurry Φ))
    (hk : ∀ s s' b, (∀ j < k, s j = s' j) → Φ s b = Φ s' b)
    (hnn : ∀ s b, 0 ≤ Φ s b) (hint : ∀ s, Integrable (Φ s) (μ : Measure Ω))
    (B : Ξ → ℝ) (hB : Integrable B (P : Measure Ξ))
    (hle : ∀ ω, (∫ b, Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) ≤ B ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω)) (P : Measure Ξ) ∧
      (∫ ω, Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω) ∂(P : Measure Ξ)) ≤ ∫ ω, B ω ∂(P : Measure Ξ) := by
  obtain ⟨hiff, heq⟩ := step_integral μ P ξ hiid k Φ hΦ hk
  have hS : Measurable (fun ω j => ξ j ω) := Measurable.of_eval (fun j => hiid.measurable j)
  have hnorm (s : ℕ → Ω) : (∫ b, ‖Φ s b‖ ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) = ∫ b, Φ s b ∂(μ : Measure Ω) := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun b => by
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hnn s b)])
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => ∫ b, Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b ∂(μ : Measure Ω))
      (P : Measure Ξ) := by
    have h1 : StronglyMeasurable (fun s : ℕ → Ω => ∫ b, Φ s b ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) :=
      hΦ.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right' (f := Function.uncurry Φ)
    exact (h1.comp_measurable hS).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hinner : Integrable (fun ω => ∫ b, Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) (P : Measure Ξ) := by
    apply hB.mono' hm
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg (fun b => hnn _ b))]
      exact hle ω)
  have hI : Integrable (fun ω => Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω)) (P : Measure Ξ) := by
    rw [hiff]
    refine ⟨Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => hint _), ?_⟩
    simp only [hnorm]
    exact hinner
  refine ⟨hI, ?_⟩
  rw [heq hI]
  exact integral_mono hinner hB hle

theorem iterate_moments (f : Point d → ℝ) (g : Point d → Ω → Point d) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
    (P : ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω) (L sigma gamma : ℝ) (x0 : Point d) (a : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hg : ∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x)
    (hlip : ∀ x y, ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (ho : LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (Point d) Ω
      (μ : Measure Ω) f g sigma)
    (hiid : LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure Ξ))
    (ha : ∀ k, a k ≤ k) (k : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun ω => delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k) ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => ‖delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure Ξ) ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => ‖gradient f (delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k)‖ ^ 2)
        (P : Measure Ξ) ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => f (delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k)) (P : Measure Ξ) := by
  have hS : Measurable (fun ω j => ξ j ω) := Measurable.of_eval (fun j => hiid.measurable j)
  have hX (j : ℕ) : Measurable (fun ω => delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) j) :=
    (delayedIterate_measurable g ho.measurable gamma a x0 j).comp hS
  have hsm := smooth_growth f L hg hlip
  have hgc : Continuous (gradient f) := (lipschitzWith_iff_norm_sub_le.mpr hlip :
    LipschitzWith ⟨L, hL.le⟩ (gradient f)).continuous
  have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun x => (hg x).hasFDerivAt.continuousAt)
  have hsub (x y : Point d) : ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hn : ‖x - y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y‖ := norm_sub_le x y
    have hh := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg (x - y)) hn 2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖x‖ - ‖y‖)]
  have hsq : ∀ m, Integrable (fun ω => ‖delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) m‖ ^ 2)
      (P : Measure Ξ) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ m ih =>
      rcases m with _ | k
      · exact integrable_const (‖x0‖ ^ 2)
      · let D : (ℕ → Ω) → Point d := fun s => delayedIterate g gamma a x0 s (a k)
        have hD : Measurable D := delayedIterate_measurable g ho.measurable gamma a x0 (a k)
        let Φ : (ℕ → Ω) → Ω → ℝ := fun s b => ‖g (D s) b‖ ^ 2
        have hΦ : Measurable (Function.uncurry Φ) :=
          (ho.measurable.comp ((hD.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)).norm.pow_const 2
        have hk : ∀ s s' b, (∀ j < k, s j = s' j) → Φ s b = Φ s' b := by
          intro s s' b h
          change ‖g (delayedIterate g gamma a x0 s (a k)) b‖ ^ 2 =
            ‖g (delayedIterate g gamma a x0 s' (a k)) b‖ ^ 2
          rw [delayedIterate_congr g gamma a x0 s s' (a k)
            (fun j hj => h j (lt_of_lt_of_le hj (ha k)))]
        have hB : Integrable (fun ω => sigma ^ 2 + (2 * ‖gradient f 0‖ ^ 2 +
            2 * L ^ 2 * ‖delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a k)‖ ^ 2)) (P : Measure Ξ) :=
          (integrable_const _).add ((integrable_const _).add
            ((ih (a k) (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (ha k))).const_mul _))
        have hle : ∀ ω, (∫ b, Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) ≤ sigma ^ 2 +
            (2 * ‖gradient f 0‖ ^ 2 +
              2 * L ^ 2 * ‖delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a k)‖ ^ 2) := by
          intro ω
          have h1 := (oracle_moments f g μ sigma ho (D (fun j => ξ j ω))).2
          have h2 := hsm.2.2 (D (fun j => ξ j ω))
          change (∫ b, ‖g (D (fun j => ξ j ω)) b‖ ^ 2 ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) ≤ _
          change _ ≤ sigma ^ 2 + (2 * ‖gradient f 0‖ ^ 2 + 2 * L ^ 2 * ‖D (fun j => ξ j ω)‖ ^ 2)
          linarith
        obtain ⟨hGi, -⟩ := step_bound μ P ξ hiid k Φ hΦ hk (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
          (fun s => (oracle_moments f g μ sigma ho (D s)).1) _ hB hle
        have hbound : Integrable (fun ω => 2 * ‖delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k‖ ^ 2 +
            2 * gamma ^ 2 * Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω)) (P : Measure Ξ) :=
          ((ih k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).const_mul 2).add (hGi.const_mul _)
        apply hbound.mono' ((hX (k + 1)).norm.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _),
          delayedIterate_succ g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k (ha k)]
        have h := hsub (delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k)
          (gamma • g (delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a k)) (ξ k ω))
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs] at h
        change _ ≤ 2 * ‖delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k‖ ^ 2 +
          2 * gamma ^ 2 * ‖g (delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a k)) (ξ k ω)‖ ^ 2
        linarith
  have hx2 := hsq k
  have hxnorm : Integrable (fun ω => ‖delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k‖) (P : Measure Ξ) :=
    (MemLp.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ 2)
      ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (hX k).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr hx2)).norm
  refine ⟨hX k, hx2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply ((integrable_const (2 * ‖gradient f 0‖ ^ 2)).add
      (hx2.const_mul (2 * L ^ 2))).mono' ((hgc.measurable.comp (hX k)).norm.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact hsm.2.2 _)
  · apply (((integrable_const |f 0|).add (hxnorm.const_mul ‖gradient f 0‖)).add
      (hx2.const_mul (L / 2))).mono' (hfc.measurable.comp (hX k)).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hsm.2.1 _)
